name: Dynamic Toscana Elite 3-Person Ultra-Low EMF Far Infared Sauna
description: Dynamic Toscana Elite 3-Person Ultra-Low EMF (Between 3-5 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Want to create a wellness retreat without leaving home? Dynamic Saunas are crafted from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood and feature Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that deliver safe, energy-efficient warmth. Each session helps reduce stress, soothe muscles, and restore your natural vitality. Designed for flexibility, these saunas can be installed in master baths, walk-in closets, basements, or even home gyms. Compact yet durable, they fit seamlessly into your lifestyle while offering lasting health and relaxation benefits. With a Dynamic Sauna, your home becomes a personal sanctuary for daily renewal. Features: Ultra Low EMF - EMF Between 3 to 5 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Full 3-person capacity Natural Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood construction Easy Removable Bench - Stretching, Exercise, or Yoga Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light feature 8 PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF 360 Carbon Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) - (Heating Panels on all 4 interior walls.) Roof vent Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth, MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Ships in 3 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 385 lbs. Shipping weight: 485 lbs. Electrical service: 110V/20amp dedicated receptacle (consult a certified electrician) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 60" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 38" x 56" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
